tema: The Subjunctive — It is essential that... be

cast_dialogue.linea: The subjunctive is the grammar of formality and urgency, heroes: 'It is essential that every photographer BE present' — no -s, no 'is'. Pure base form.
The director insisted that I attend the ceremony in person. It was essential that every photographer be at the rehearsal.
The organizers demanded that the lights be tested twice. It was vital that nobody touch the equipment.
I suggested that the speech be short, and Abuela Carmen recommended that everyone arrive early.
It is crucial that everything go perfectly, mis héroes. If the ceremony were cancelled, months of work would be lost.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: The subjunctive uses the BASE form for all persons after: insist, demand, suggest, recommend, request, require + that; and it is essential/vital/crucial/important + that. No 's' in third person, 'be' instead of is/are, and negation is 'not + verb' (no 'don't').

filas: It is essential/vital + that + base form
It is vital that he be present.
I be, you be, he be
They demanded that he be fired.
It is vital that nobody touch it.
